hooks.command: bash -c 'TID="${OPENCLAUDE_THREAD_ID:-0}"; TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); echo "=== WORKSPACE MEMORY ==="; cat memory/MEMORY.md 2>/dev/null || echo "(no workspace memory yet)"; echo; if [ "$TID" != "0" ]; then echo "=== TOPIC MEMORY (t$TID) ==="; cat "memory/t$TID/MEMORY.md" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no topic memory yet)"; echo; else HAS_TOPIC_MEM=0; for f in memory/t*/MEMORY.md; do [ -f "$f" ] && [ "$f" != "memory/t0/MEMORY.md" ] && HAS_TOPIC_MEM=1 && break; done; if [ "$HAS_TOPIC_MEM" = "1" ]; then echo "=== ALL TOPIC MEMORIES ==="; for f in memory/t*/MEMORY.md; do [ -f "$f" ] && [ "$f" != "memory/t0/MEMORY.md" ] && echo "--- $f ---" && cat "$f" && echo; done; echo; fi; fi; echo "=== TODAY DAILY LOGS (t$TID/$TODAY) ==="; LOGDIR="memory/t$TID/$TODAY"; if [ -d "$LOGDIR" ]; then for f in "$LOGDIR"/*.md; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "--- $(basename "$f") ---" && cat "$f" && echo; done; else echo "(no daily logs today yet)"; fi; echo; echo "[Save topic memory to memory/t$TID/MEMORY.md]"; echo "[Save daily logs to memory/t$TID/$TODAY/]"; echo "[Save workspace-wide memory to memory/MEMORY.md]"; echo "[Topic thread ID: $TID]"; echo "[IMPORTANT: Your working directory is $PWD. Read ALL files (IDENTITY.md, USER.md, TOOLS.md, memory/) from here. Do NOT search or read from parent directories.]"'
